_notes: identities is BOTH the allowlist and the identity map: a phone number not
listed here is ignored entirely (no reply, no brain). Map each number to
the sender's Entra object id so Teams and iMessage share one brain.
allowActions=false makes iMessage capture-only: tasks/ideas/questions work,
but tool actions (Smartsheet writes, scheduling) are saved and deferred to
Teams. Flip to true once you've made the governance call about work data
Runtime credentials come from SPECTRUM_PROJECT_ID / SPECTRUM_PROJECT_SECRET.
